MONDAY,  JULY  1,  2024 / ASHADHA  10,  1946 
Separate paging is given to this part in order that it may be filed as a Separate Compilation. 
 
PART   I-A 
CENTRAL SECTION 
Orders  and  Notifications  (Other than those published in Part IV-B) 
under the Gujarat Local Boards, Village Panchayats, Municipal 
Boroughs, District Municipal, Primary Education and Local Fund Audit Acts. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 1st July, 2024 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993. 
No. KP/18 of 2024//ELC/PRHRDD/GRT/e-file/14/2023/5975/Section-G:- The following draft of rules which is 
proposed to be issued under section 274 read with sub-section (5) of section 9 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 
(Guj.18 of 1993) (hereinafter referred as “The said Act”) is published as required by sub-section (5) of section 274 of 
the said Act, for the information of all persons likely to be affected thereby and notice is hereby given that the said draft 
will be taken into consideration by the Government of Gujarat on or after the expiry of the period of thirty days from 
the date of publication of this notification in the Official Gazette.  
2. 
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the Principal Secretary to the Government of Gujarat, 
Panchayats, Rural Housing and Rural Development Department, Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, from any person 
with respect to the said draft rules on or before the expiry of the aforesaid period will be considered by the 
Government.  
I-A Ex.-18 
18-1

GUJARAT GOVERNMENT GAZETTE, EX., 01-07-2024 
 [ PART  I-A 
DRAFT NOTIFICATION 
No. KP/18 of 2024//ELC/PRHRDD/GRT/e-file/14/2023/5975/Section-G:- In exercise of the powers conferred by 
section 274 read with sub-section (5) of section 9 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj.18 of 1993), the 
Government of Gujarat hereby makes the following rules further to amend the Gujarat Village Panchayats Election 
(Manner of Allotment of Reserved Seats by Rotation) Rules, 1994, namely:- 
1. 
(1) 
These rules may be called the Gujarat Village Panchayats Election (Manner of Allotment of Reserved 
Seats by Rotation) (Amendment) Rules, 2024. 
(2) 
They shall come into force from the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. 
In the Gujarat Village Panchayats Election (Manner of Allotment of Reserved Seats by Rotation) Rules, 1994, in 
rule 6, in sub-rule (5), for the words, brackets and figures “under sub-clause (ii) of clause (a) of sub-section (5) 
of section 9 of the Act, ten percent of the total number of seats in the village panchayats of that village", the 
words, brackets and figures "twenty-seven per cent. of the total number of seats in the village panchayats of that 
village subject to the provisos to sub-clause (ii) of clause (a) of sub-section (5) of section 9 of the Act" shall be 
substituted. 
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat, 
SIMRAN POPTANI, 
Deputy Secretary to Government. 
---------- 
 
Signed by:BHOLUSINGH G THAKUR
Date: 2024.07.02 18:31:09 +05:30
Reason: Validate Document
Location: Government Central Press,
Gandhinagar
Signature Not Verified
